ctx.x: Who did Billie like to play behind her on trumpet?
Oh, Clayton usually, in the band.

items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: So then he asked me would I, would I, since he's essentially going to New York and since we're going into the Roseland Ballroom... Was this the first time you met Basie? Yes... how long did you play there in this band with Basie? About a month.

ctx.x: That wasn't, at this time that wasn't your forte really?
No, Basie always wanted me to do that.
Right. Now who do you work with first when you get out to California?
